mechanism.claim: A large six-hour acceleration in the FX-adjusted Upbit KRW-BTC premium during unusually high BTC realized variation measures a fresh local cash-demand impulse rather than a static regional valuation gap. The premium-change direction should relay into BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: sign of current 00:00 premium minus the exact 18:00 premium six hours earlier
mechanism.why_distinct: KPAR is a symmetric fixed daily cross-venue premium-acceleration clock. Gross9 fresh_kimchi_fx is an asymmetric funding/flow/local-impulse or USDKRW/HTF policy on a dense stride; KPAR uses none of its thresholds, event rows, funding, taker flow, or BTC directional-return conditions.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed six-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one weekday 00:05 UTC premium-acceleration clock should have low structural overlap with the dense asymmetric Gross9 sleeve

features.hourly_premium: last observed Upbit KRW-BTC close divided by last observed Binance BTCUSDT perpetual close times last observed Polygon USDKRW close, minus one
features.hour_validity: completed hour, Upbit >=30 distinct minutes with first<=minute05 and last>=minute55; Binance >=55 with first<=minute01 and last>=minute59; USDKRW >=40 with first<=minute10 and last>=minute55; finite positive closes; no imputation
features.premium_change: premium at exact weekday D 00:00 minus premium at exact D-6h, both valid
features.premium_change_z: standardized against at most 90 strictly prior valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; prior sample std positive
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum of six squared completed-hour Binance BTC log returns ending at decision)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid weekday decisions, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 00:00 UTC after all three source hours and six-hour BTC path are complete
clock.reservation: fixed weekday decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent local-cash premium-transmission mechanism for volatile BTC

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, direction, hold, clock, freshness, or subset repair.
